title: DataMart Platform Engineer Senior
description:
**Position Type :**

Full time

**Type Of Hire :**

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)

**Education Desired :**

Bachelor's Degree

**DataMart Platform Engineer Senior – 7-12 Yrs Experience – Pune Location**

**About the Team**

As a Lead Support Engineer – DataMart Platform Operations, you will provide technical and operational leadership for business-critical DataMart services supporting reporting, analytics, downstream interfaces and client processing. You will join a team responsible for the reliability and operational support of business-critical DataMart services supporting reporting, analytics, downstream interfaces and client processing. The team works across application engineering, Oracle databases, infrastructure, batch scheduling, managed file transfer and reporting technologies to resolve complex production issues.

**What You Will Be Doing**

  

* Lead production and non-production support for DataMart environments, monitoring platform health, data loads, interfaces and reporting availability.
* Oversee end-to-end batch processing, validating source extracts, ingestion, transformation, dependencies and completion within required service windows.
* Lead technical recovery during critical incidents across application, database, scheduling, file-transfer, batch and reporting layers.
* Perform advanced Oracle troubleshooting, including SQL, PL/SQL, execution plans, contention, data-quality issues and batch-processing bottlenecks.
* Drive root-cause analysis for recurring or high-impact incidents and implement sustainable corrective actions that improve platform reliability.
* Support SAP BusinessObjects and Web Intelligence services, resolving reporting availability, connectivity, authentication, scheduling and DataMart-related failures.
* Lead operational readiness for releases, patches, schema changes, environment refreshes, migrations, cutovers, rollback planning and post-production stabilization.
* Develop and enhance scripts, monitoring and operational tooling to improve detection, validation, recovery and reduce manual intervention.
* Support disaster-recovery planning and exercises, maintain recovery procedures, dependency information and validation checklists across platform components.
* Provide technical direction and mentoring to support engineers while coordinating effectively with applications, databases, infrastructure and client-support teams.

**What you Bring**

  

* 7–10 years of experience in DataMart, data warehouse, application, database or enterprise production support.
* 3+ years of experience in a senior or lead technical capacity supporting business-critical enterprise platforms.
* Strong Oracle Database troubleshooting experience, including performance analysis, execution plans, contention and high-volume processing issues.
* Advanced SQL and PL/SQL skills, including troubleshooting packages, procedures, data loads and data-quality issues.
* Strong Linux/Unix experience with shell scripting or comparable automation capabilities.
* Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise batch processing, workload scheduling, ETL workflows and managed file-transfer processes.
* Strong incident management, problem management and root-cause analysis skills across database, application and infrastructure layers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience supporting SAP BusinessObjects and Web Intelligence in enterprise production environments.
* Experience with CI/CD practices, database deployment automation, monitoring, alerting and service-management platforms.
* Experience with Oracle database maintenance, capacity management, schema changes, imports, exports, upgrades and environment refreshes.
* Experience improving production reliability through automation, proactive monitoring and reusable diagnostic tooling.
* Knowledge of disaster recovery, service resilience, release management and production-readiness practices.
* Strong communication and technical leadership skills, including coordinating distributed teams during complex production incidents.

**What We Offer you**

At FIS, you can grow your career as far as you want to take it. Here’s what else we offer:

* Opportunities to make an impact in fintech
* Personal and professional learning
* Inclusive, diverse work environment
* Competitive salary and benefits

**Privacy Statement**

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

**Sourcing Model**

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

title: Database & Migration Engineer
description:
Role summary

You own the data. You build the SQL Server environment in Azure, move the production database with log shipping and reconciliation, and prepare the application servers for the application vendor's install. Your work is the critical path on cutover night.

Key responsibilities

* Build and tune SQL Server on Azure VMs per the capacity plan
* Plan and run the data migration: initial seed, log shipping, validation and reconciliation
* Run the migration rehearsal and prepare the rollback path
* Prepare application servers in the private subnet and support the application vendor's install and validation
* Carry out the database and application steps on the cutover night
* Run database restore checks as part of backup testing
* Contribute to testing, hypercare and knowledge transfer

Deliverables you own

Configured SQL Server environment · data migration plan · data reconciliation report · application installation and validation record

Must-have

* 5+ years as a SQL Server DBA, including 3+ years on migrations to Azure or other cloud
* Hands-on with log shipping, backup/restore, and large-database seeding (including bandwidth-limited links)
* SQL Server performance tuning, storage layout on Azure VMs, and HA/DR concepts
* Rigorous data validation and reconciliation habits (row counts, checksums, application-level checks)
* Comfort working alongside a software vendor's installers without owning their application
* PowerShell or T-SQL automation skills

Good to have

* Experience with healthcare databases (HIS, RIS/PACS) and patient-data sensitivity
* Azure Database Migration tooling, Always On Availability Groups
* Experience with cutover planning for 24x7 clinical systems

What independence looks like

You can own the migration plan from seed to final sync, run the rehearsal, and tell the team with evidence whether the data is ready for go-live.

Send your CV with two or three examples of Azure migration or equivalent projects you delivered independently, what you personally owned, and your notice period. Shortlisted candidates will have a technical interview followed by a short scenario exercise relevant to the role.

**Location:** Remote (some availability overlap with GST, UTC+3) · **Onsite visits:** only if the client requires, with travel arranged by the client side

Pay: From ₹371,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Pune, Maharashtra

title: Consultant (Technical) - Hybrid Work Model
description:
**Consultant (Technical)**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Model of Work: Hybrid**

  

**About Quorum Software**

Quorum Software connects people and information across the energy value chain. Twenty years ago, we built the first software for gas plant accountants. Pipeline operators came next, followed by land administrators, pumpers, and planners. Since 1998, Quorum has helped thousands of energy workers with business workflows that optimize profitability and growth. Our vision for the future connects the global energy ecosystem through cloud-first software, data standards, and integration. The trusted source of decision-ready data for 1,800+ companies, Quorum Software makes the essential connections that let us work better together in the connected energy workplace. For more information, visit quorumsoftware.com

**Be a part of our legacy**

Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.

**Who we are looking for:**

Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation.

**Job Purpose**

The Consultant (Technical) is an experienced team member of the Professional Services (PS) business unit. They are responsible for planning and overseeing technical team activities to develop complex technical upgrades of customer solutions as well as install and deploy to customer environments. This role will require the individual to become an expert in Quorum’s enterprise software architecture and deployment processes, including maintenance of heavily customized code, databases, and installations, and to mentor other team members in these areas.

**What You Will Do:**

* Execute end-to-end technical upgrades to latest software versions across dozens of enterprise customers, from incremental monthly patches to major upgrades of versions 5+ years out of date
* Perform complex technical tasks independently, including database upgrade packaging, custom database object remediation, analysis of code customizations, development of outdated custom features in latest code version, deployment of Azure DevOps pipelines, and on-premise environment installations
* Perform assigned work with quality, timely delivery, and documentation. This includes proactively collaborating with team members to overcome any technical challenges and roadblocks.
* Balance workload priorities across multiple concurrent upgrades and deliverables for various customers
* Demonstrate mastery and drive improvements for technical skills required for successful deployments & upgrades, such as: SQL, NuGet, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and in-house Quorum tools.

* Participate in stand-ups and retrospectives to identify technical and process issues, discuss improvement ideas, and share knowledge
* Serve as a Quorum Subject Matter Expert (SME) in client conversations while representing Quorum positively
* Serve as a technical SME in several areas of our products and architecture
* Understand, follow, and broadcast process changes among team members
* And other duties as assigned.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum 2+ years of experience in software deployments or development,
* Strong programming skills (C++/C# or similar) including developing enhancements, performing code reviews, and resolving bugs
* Strong database skills (SQL) including writing complex functions/procedures, converting and managing large sets of data, and troubleshooting issues
* Demonstrated ownership of own commitments to high-quality software deliverables and customer experience
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal

**Preferred Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering, technology, or other analytical discipline
* Development or deployment experience working in an Agile environment
* Experience with cloud solutions and complex integrations

**Nice to Have:**

* Familiarity with TFS – In case developer needs to look at code previously developed in older versions
* Ability to debug and troubleshoot application bugs in Visual Studio
* Exposure to Oil & Gas domain

**Additional Details**

* Visa Sponsorship: Employment eligibility to work with Quorum Software in India is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for this position.

  

**Quorum Diversity Statement**:At Quorum, we are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of belonging. We want to be the place where a diverse pool of talented people join us, stay with us and do their best work. With a diverse team of employees, we grow and learn better together. The collective sum of the individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression, and talent that our employees invest in their work represents not only part of our culture, but our reputation and our achievements. We are fully focused on equity and equality and believe deeply in diversity of race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ethnicity, national origin, ability, neurodiversity and all the other characteristics that make us unique.

*Quorum Business Solutions and Quorum Software are Equal Opportunity Employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.*

**Those applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application and/or interview process should notify a member of the Human Resources Department**
